example: The meeting is in Room 12 now. Please write it down so you do not go to the old room.
pattern: write down the number / write the number down / write it down
register: Everyday and workplace; separable phrasal verb
frequencyEvidence: Cambridge labels the record-in-writing sense B1. Oxford confirms the same memory/recording purpose and separable pattern; no numeric frequency claim.

check.question: Why should the listener write the room number down?
check.expectedAnswer: To remember the new meeting room.

practice.personalUse: Ask a colleague to record a phone number.
practice.laterReview: Retrieve when taking a telephone message.

sourceStatus: Original WordPix example; English sense, pattern, register, and level re-reviewed online against Cambridge and Oxford learner dictionaries on 2026-09-30. Arabic meaning reviewed for the exact taught sense.

sourceReview.finding: Cambridge B1; Oxford confirms the exact everyday recording sense and pattern.
